mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, source, source_priority, amount, remaining, frozen, expires_at, biz_type, biz_id, version FROM billing_credit_lots WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) ORDER BY (expires_at IS NULL), expires_at ASC, source_priority ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(remaining - frozen), 0) FROM billing_credit_lots WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW())
SELECT source, COALESCE(SUM(remaining - frozen), 0) AS credits FROM billing_credit_lots WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) GROUP BY source
SELECT user_id, COALESCE(SUM(remaining - frozen), 0) AS amount FROM billing_credit_lots WHERE user_id IN #{uid} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) GROUP BY user_id

SELECT id, user_id, source, source_priority, amount, remaining, frozen, expires_at, biz_type, biz_id, version FROM billing_credit_lots WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= NOW() AND remaining > frozen ORDER BY expires_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, user_id, source, source_priority, amount, remaining, frozen, expires_at, biz_type, biz_id, version FROM billing_credit_lots WHERE id = #{lotId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, user_id, source, amount, remaining, frozen, expires_at, version FROM billing_credit_lots WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at > NOW() AND remaining > frozen ORDER BY expires_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE billing_credit_lots SET frozen = frozen + #{amount}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{lotId}
UPDATE billing_credit_lots SET frozen = frozen - #{amount}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{lotId}
UPDATE billing_credit_lots SET frozen = frozen - #{frozenTake}, remaining = remaining - #{actualTake}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{lotId}
UPDATE billing_credit_lots SET remaining = remaining - #{amount}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{lotId}
